meta.title: Liquid Ink — Effects Platform · Theme 05
meta.description: Luminous ink drops that bloom, bleed, and dissolve in dark water between slides.

blocks.text: Luminous ink blooms in still water — feathered tendrils, bright rims, and a slow settle.
Noise-warped blots with tendrils, granulation, and watercolor rims — grown from a birth time, not a video.

items.title: Drops
items.text: A pool of twelve slots; scenes arrange them like pigment on wet paper.

items.title: Tendrils
items.text: Shared warp fields feather every edge — organic, never twice the same.

items.title: Settle
items.text: Drops bloom bright, then calm into the water until the next slide stirs it.

blocks.text: Blue from the left, pink from the right — the collide scene stages every either/or you'll ever present.
